gate: No T16 original source birth or source-only synthetic qualification until the mechanism-design coverage and controls are locked at the exact head; preimplementation synthetic families are not independently originated science.

Wingless.idea: constant-domain affine/permutation image propagation plus learned public query ordering; exact fallback
persistent joint role-variable constraints and incremental public evidence certificates; no per-task enumeration
calibrated TRAIN uncertainty estimates ONLY for work triage; certifier sound by construction and exact fallback

Yggdrasil.idea: packed source-blind learned graph-corridor witness sketch, no original graph retention
online lossless component encoding and reversible junction retention with bounded aliases
train public delayed credit to predict incremental future compositional utility; no future OPEN query access
Yggdrasil.distinct_from: single-edge credit trained on TRAIN path

Mass.idea: infer role-inverse/composition constraints solely from shared PUBLIC TRAIN evidence, compare to equally informed independently trained structural solver
Mass.distinct_from: T16 manually seeded exact source structural relation

Mass.idea: learn compact primitive role embeddings with closed-form composition under equal shared state and finite compute
learn public witness allocation over new relationship classes with frozen equal-query comparator

objective.primary: independent replicated held-out gain over the strongest equal-information frozen trained and symbolic controls with zero hard false positives, zero baseline-correct regressions, and complete CPU+RSS+query cost <= strongest eligible control
objective.advisory_preference: Maximize conservative expected information gain per total CPU+memory cost (TRAIN amortization and verification counted), not positive-like historical reward.
objective.disallowed: No reward for source-verified CI green, invalid first-use events, training-only progress, source-tag memorization, duplicate variants of previously failed mechanism without causal delta
objective.relative_order: First original source legitimacy, then safety/resource nonregression, then learned gain, then information efficiency

candidate_registry_contract.audit: Append all filtered, ineligible, negative and chosen candidate decisions; no optimizerbridge.LaneEvidence produced
candidate_registry_contract.diversity: Select at most one genuinely distinct mechanism family per lane, independently sourced; disallow selection of same-family clones for identical task
candidate_registry_contract.tie_break: Deterministic sorted by conservative utility then stable id; no auto-dispatch

optimizer_roles.Dream-RSI: Generate/score bounded policy proposals using signed historical science only as negative/uncertain context; no scientific acceptance
optimizer_roles.Pareto/evolutionary: Maintain nondominated distinct families over expected info gain, complete compute, memory and risk; preserve dominated failures
optimizer_roles.ThetaEvolve: Explore source-blind mechanism primitives and recombinations with frozen TRAIN-only feedback, never learn a supposed positive from unsigned T15/T16
optimizer_roles.Promptbreeder/DGM/GenEnv: Optional source-blind proposals within fixed lane and budget, not new controller/workflow/policy authority
